summary.text: Beast Calamity grotto-heaven is a grotto-heaven Fang Yuan finds in immemorial white heaven.

claims.text: Heaven form’s crane flies in circles. Heaven form identifies this as Beast Calamity grotto-heaven. It has not annexed any nine heavens fragment.
The grotto-heaven’s entrance is closed and hidden in empty space, not visible to the naked eye.

Inside, cities stand under a clear sky with white cloud. Tall city walls reach only to the knees of a mountain-sized invader. A huge crowd fills one city, and four city gates open onto its streets. The main street is so narrow that even enlarged five or six times it would still vanish under that invader’s heel, and buildings there crumble like small paper boxes when struck.
A forest of countless gigantic trees stands as Spirit Spring Forest. Named ground inside also includes Sacred Eagle City and Dark Valley.
Outside one city wall, a Combat Beast Warrior moves to the wall top while a silver-white giant eagle comes from the horizon, and the fused beast warrior stands as tall as the wall.

The original owner was a transformation path rank eight Gu Immortal who had passed one myriad tribulation. Heaven form shows that every calamity and tribulation here becomes a beast calamity: heavenly tribulations as desolate beast calamities, grand tribulations as ancient desolate beast calamities, and myriad tribulations as immemorial desolate beast calamities. The grotto-heaven does not restrict tribulation types. It transforms their formation into ferocious beasts. Fang Yuan compares it with Profound Literature grotto-heaven: every grotto-heaven that can continuously exist is not simple, and this one is even more so. It holds a huge population, countless resources, and the beast calamity transformation method.

Fang Yuan enters through heaven form’s white light. He is not blocked by a rank eight Gu Immortal this time, because there is no rank eight existence in this grotto-heaven. The grotto-heaven shakes and treats him as a tribulation because he came from outside. Temporary transformation path dao marks are added to his body, and his other dao marks change into transformation path dao marks. He becomes a mountain-sized monster with a bull head and human body. Inhabitants shout to call Combat Beast Warriors, and Eagle Warrior appears to defend the homeland.

Fang Yuan stops in immemorial white heaven and locates Beast Calamity grotto-heaven from his previous life’s memories. The entrance is closed and hidden in empty space. Heaven form confirms the grotto-heaven is still an isolated world that does not interact with the outside world. Any living being that enters is affected by myriad beings assimilation transformation and turned into a beast calamity. He spits a grey soul ball into the grotto-heaven, the killer move soul replacement, and the ball occupies a young man’s body as Zhan Bu Du.
